blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Archdiocese of Cebu on Tuesday, September 15, launched the “I Choose God” movement, a campaign aimed at strengthening voter education, conscience formation, and responsible citizenship among Cebuanos. The campaign seeks to promote good governance and values formation beyond elections as the country continues to face environmental, economic, and social challenges. Cebu Archbishop Alberto “Abet” Uy described the campaign as a long-term movement. It aims to promote responsible citizenship and good governance through conscience formation aligned with Church teachings. “Ang laing naguba mao ang konsensya sa mga tao.
